audits.text:
## 102e79f0ca6d

**Finding A1 — ordinary default generation can violate its own contact-boundary premise.**

Generator SHA-256: `74f5fe2494a820c7f0d84cc2d5a6a3c1204ecefa3221d18f8e9390e82c88f2f8`  
Generator version: `3.0.1`  
Executed canonical rule hash: `bcebb1f543e7`

A default easy draw at seed `2`, sample index `3`, with no overrides, returns a 10×10 grid containing a two-cell color-4 component and a three-cell color-6 component, both isolated. It therefore has no adjacent differently colored cells and fails the target’s own validator with:

```text
no two adjacent cells of different colors — no contact boundary
```

The input belongs to the ordinary documented generator domain; it is not a hand-built degenerate texture. The selected Racket rule lawfully returns an all-zero grid because there are no contact cells. That produces a training item with no positive example of the advertised transformation.

The root cause is direct in `generate()`: after placing blob A with `isolate=True`, it calls `_try_place(..., isolate=False)` for blob B but ignores the returned boolean. If all 80 random attempts fail to place B adjacent to a differently colored existing cell, A remains isolated and generation continues. The same omission can also make the advertised contact-pair count inexact.

A bounded census over seeds `0..99`, sample indices `0..19`, and all three bands found **2 invalid default draws out of 6,000**; both were in easy (`2/2,000`). This low frequency explains why light sampling can miss the defect, but it is deterministic and replayable.

Evidence:

- exact input: `checks/audit/102e79f0ca6d/input.json`
- Racket output and source/rule hashes: `checks/audit/102e79f0ca6d/racket.json`
- reproducer, 6,000-draw counts, first examples, and root-cause record: `checks/audit/102e79f0ca6d/reproducer.json`
- runnable probe: `checks/audit/102e79f0ca6d/reproduce.py`

Suggested repair, not applied here: make each contact pair transactional—remove A or retry the whole pair when B placement fails—and assert exact realized pair counts in `self_check`/override observation. Add the seed `2`, index `3`, easy case as a regression.

audits.text:
## 102e79f0ca6d

**Reproduced defect — the declared generator/validator contract is not falsifiable enough.** Source hash `74f5fe2494a820c7f0d84cc2d5a6a3c1204ecefa3221d18f8e9390e82c88f2f8` fails 3 of 12 battery stages (`lint`, `defect_lint`, and `override`); see `checks/audit/102e79f0ca6d/battery/checks/102e79f0ca6d_before_battery_summary.json`. The override stage reports that declared values such as `difficulty="easy", height=7` are rejected even though `AXES["height"]["valid"]` says `7..15`, and that unknown override names are silently accepted. The defect lint also reports four dead texture values and an undeclared lawful degenerate.

The validator independently accepts an exact 7x8 counterexample containing only two differently colored adjacent cells: `self_check` returns `[]` even though the module's own invariant requires some cells in the contacting components not to be contact cells. The dimensions are inside the advertised 7..15 by 8..16 domain, but the scene is outside the documented teaching manifold. The exact input, source/rule hashes, validator result, and authority output are in `checks/audit/102e79f0ca6d/validator_counterexample.json`; the selected Racket receipt is `checks/audit/102e79f0ca6d/racket.json`. A second probe shows `self_check` also accepts color 10 and a 1x2 grid (`checks/audit/102e79f0ca6d/self_check_probe.json`).

**Suggested repair:** pin `RULE_HASH`; reject unknown overrides; make every advertised exact axis observable and legal over its declared domain (or narrow/declare incompatibilities); and make `self_check` enforce dimensions, ARC colors, at least one non-contact foreground cell, and the remaining stated invariants. I did not modify this audit target.
